about: How a failing rule of the Template Customization Question Readiness check weighs on the Road to live step Customize your site. must-fix: the customer answers one of the 7 questions and the site does not change, or breaks; it holds Publish. worth-fixing: the answer works but leaves a small leftover; it only warns. question: the Customize your site question the rule is about. text: the one plain line /ops shows when the rule fails. reason: why the rule is in its group, from the spec (tasks/spec-template-customization-question-readiness.md). Edit this file to move a rule; no code change is needed.

REL-2.question: Pages
REL-2.text: Some pages are missing from the list, so the customer cannot remove them.
REL-2.reason: A page the Pages question does not list stays on the site whatever the customer unticks.

REL-3.question: Logo
REL-3.text: It asks for the wrong kind of logo, so the uploaded logo misses its place.
REL-3.reason: A light or dark logo the question never asks for is never written to the site.

NAME-1.question: Business name
NAME-1.text: The home page tab keeps the demo name.
NAME-1.reason: The business name answer does not reach the home page title.

NAME-2.question: Business name
NAME-2.text: Inner page tabs keep the demo name.
NAME-2.reason: The business name answer does not reach the title of inner pages.

FAV-1.question: Favicon
FAV-1.text: The tab does not show the uploaded icon alone.
FAV-1.reason: The favicon answer is not applied, or the demo icon still shows beside it.

LOGO-1.question: Logo
LOGO-1.text: Some pages keep the demo logo.
LOGO-1.reason: The logo answer is not applied everywhere the demo logo sits.

LOGO-2.question: Logo
LOGO-2.text: Dark mode shows the wrong logo or recolours it.
LOGO-2.reason: The dark logo answer is not applied, or the template paints over it.

LOGO-3.question: Logo
LOGO-3.text: The uploaded logo does not fit: the header grows or covers the menu.
LOGO-3.reason: The spec counts a swollen header or a logo over the menu as a broken page.

NAME-3.question: Business name
NAME-3.text: The copyright line keeps the demo name.
NAME-3.reason: The business name answer does not reach the copyright line of every page.

NAME-4.question: Business name
NAME-4.text: Characters like & or accents come out wrong.
NAME-4.reason: The business name shows, but not as the customer typed it.

ABOUT-1.question: About
ABOUT-1.text: The home heading does not take the description.
ABOUT-1.reason: The about answer has no place to land on the home page.

ABOUT-2.question: About
ABOUT-2.text: Pages keep paragraphs about the demo business.
ABOUT-2.reason: Whole paragraphs of another business remain once the customer describes theirs.

ABOUT-3.question: Business name
ABOUT-3.text: The demo company name stays in the text.
ABOUT-3.reason: The template does not declare its demo company name, so Tracy cannot rename it.

HIDDEN-1.question: Business name
HIDDEN-1.text: The 404, search, Terms or Privacy pages keep demo facts.
HIDDEN-1.reason: Pages off the menu keep demo words; the main pages still change.

SHARE-1.question: Business name
SHARE-1.text: A shared link previews demo words.
SHARE-1.reason: Only the link preview keeps demo text; the site itself changes.

STAB-1.question: All questions
STAB-1.text: The build does not finish in one press, or an answer has no place.
STAB-1.reason: A build that fails, or an answer Tracy cannot write, breaks the whole sheet.

STAB-2.question: All questions
STAB-2.text: A page shows a technical error.
STAB-2.reason: A page with an error is a broken site.

STAB-6.question: All questions
STAB-6.text: Tracy cannot edit the site right after the build.
STAB-6.reason: A site Tracy cannot edit breaks every change the customer asks for next.

STAB-7.question: All questions
STAB-7.text: Machine text like null or {contact.tel} shows on a page.
STAB-7.reason: Raw placeholders on a page read as a broken site.

PAGE-1.question: Pages
PAGE-1.text: A page the customer unticked still opens.
PAGE-1.reason: The Pages answer is ignored for that page.

PAGE-2.question: Pages
PAGE-2.text: A kept page breaks or loses its own content.
PAGE-2.reason: Keeping a page must never break it.

PAGE-4.question: Pages
PAGE-4.text: Links lead to removed pages or to error pages.
PAGE-4.reason: A dead link after the Pages answer is a broken site.

PAGE-5.question: Pages
PAGE-5.text: Some buttons lead to a page their words do not name.
PAGE-5.reason: The button still leads somewhere; only its target is off.

PAGE-7.question: Pages
PAGE-7.text: Articles of an unticked page still open.
PAGE-7.reason: The unticked page is gone; only articles under it remain reachable.

PAGE-8.question: Pages
PAGE-8.text: Search engines may still see pages that are not public.
PAGE-8.reason: Visitors do not see it; only the sitemap or index rules lag behind.

LANG-1.question: Site language
LANG-1.text: The page tells browsers the wrong language.
LANG-1.reason: The words change; only the page's language tag is off.

LANG-2.question: Site language
LANG-2.text: Some words stay in another language.
LANG-2.reason: The language answer is not applied to every word the visitor reads.

LANG-3.question: Site language
LANG-3.text: Words in another writing system remain.
LANG-3.reason: Text the visitor cannot read is left on the page.

LANG-5.question: Site language
LANG-5.text: The site keeps more than one language.
LANG-5.reason: The language answer does not make the site one language.

LANG-6.question: Site language
LANG-6.reason: The words change; only the date order or month names stay English.
